text: The contrapositive of the implication P → Q is:
explanation: The contrapositive of P → Q is ¬Q → ¬P, and it is logically equivalent to the original. Q → P is the converse and ¬P → ¬Q is the inverse; neither is equivalent to P → Q (they are equivalent only to each other). Confusing the contrapositive with the converse is a classic error.
